Why people are worried

Fast.
Cheap.
Tireless.

Fast

The Good News
04 / 10
But here's the good news

AI is powerful —
but far from perfect.

Statement · 04
Three limits
Why it matters
01

It can copy, but it can't truly imagine.

02

It produces words, but doesn't understand them.

03

It has no feelings and no real experience.

And that is exactly where our chance lies.

Four Human Skills
05 / 10 · Skill 01
Skill 01 · What machines can't do

Stay
Creative

AI learns from the past — it remixes what already exists. Truly new ideas, original stories and bold designs still come from human imagination.

The more creative you are, the harder you are to replace.
Four Human Skills
06 / 10 · Skill 02
Skill 02 · The human advantage

Connect with People

A Machines
Process
data.

Fast, precise, tireless — but cold. They compute; they don't care.

  • Crunch the numbers
  • Follow the rules
  • Repeat forever
B People
Build
trust.

We comfort, inspire and lead. Empathy is something no algorithm can copy.

  • Comfort a friend
  • Inspire a team
  • Lead with heart
Four Human Skills
07 / 10 · Skill 03
Skill 03 · Stay in control

Think for Yourself

AI gives answers — sometimes confidently wrong ones. The judgement stays human.

01
Ask good questions
The right question is worth more than a fast answer.
02
Check the facts
Don't trust blindly — verify before you believe.
03
Judge for yourself
You decide what's true. The tool serves you, not the other way round.

The Takeaway
09 / 10
Remember this

AI won't replace you. A person using AI will.

Don't compete with AI — learn to work with it. Make it your partner, not your enemy.
